profile.name: TVD HOLDINGS PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company operates business by holding shares in other companies (Holding Company). The principal business operations of the Group are sales of goods and services through various marketing channels including providing, producing TV programs and selling of air time for advertising.
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company shall pay dividends at not less than 55 percent of net profit after deduction of corporate income tax and after deduction of all types of reserves as required by law. The consideration for payment of dividends shall depend on cash flow, the sufficiency of working capital for business operations, investment plan, repayment of loans, terms and conditions of various agreements to which the Company is bound, as well as legal restrictions, necessities, and other appropriateness in the future. The resolution of the Board of Directors of the Company approving the payment of dividends shall be submitted for approval of the meeting of shareholders, except for the payment of interim dividends, which the Board of Directors of the Company has the power to approve from time to time when it is of the view that the Company has sufficient profits to do so, provided that such payment shall be reported to the meeting of shareholders at the next meeting.
profile.auditChoice: Unqualified opinion with an emphasis of matters
